personal_info.title: Applied AI & Automation Engineer
personal_info.tagline: I design, build, and operate production ERP data platforms, AI workflows, CRM systems, and field apps for a four-brand industrial group—working directly with leadership from business question to production. Remote EU / US.

highlights.label: Field & ops PWA in daily production

phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.title: PHC ERP · Cloud Read Replica & Semantic Layer
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.problem: Two companies ran on separate on-prem ERP databases and Excel—CRM, automation, and leadership had no single trusted view of revenue, debt, stock, or customers.
phc_cloud_data_platform_elt.built: Outbound-only Python incremental sync into PostgreSQL, dbt semantic marts (67 models, 114 tests), Metabase executive dashboards, and read-only MCP metric tools.
impact: 5M+ rows across 46 allowlisted tables on a 15-minute incremental cadence (99.1% 7-day sync success)
Single reconciled metrics catalog with daily ERP checks and a 49-question regression suite (unaudited revenue visibility; accountant sign-off pending)
Decoupled ~11.4k CRM customer migrations and executive BI from on-prem SQL Server

habitai_unified_platform.title: HABITAI · Unified Operations Cockpit
habitai_unified_platform.problem: Operational data lived across ERP, CRM, logistics, and spreadsheets with no shared cockpit for owners or commercial teams.
habitai_unified_platform.built: Multi-brand Next.js and FastAPI cockpit unifying governed ERP metrics, read-only MCP Q&A, multimodal technical RAG, Distribution 360, debt auditing, and predictive inventory.
impact: Read-only MCP orchestration over governed dbt marts so leadership queries live KPIs safely
Multimodal RAG pipeline (Docling, ColPali, Qdrant, BGE/Jina rerankers) for technical product consultation
Distribution 360, debt investigator, and predictive inventory over ~7.1k active SKUs by unit of measure

blinds_field_ops_pwa.title: app-tecnicos · Field Operations PWA
blinds_field_ops_pwa.problem: Field installation and warehouse prep ran on WhatsApp, spreadsheets, and phone calls with no live visit state when customers called.
blinds_field_ops_pwa.built: Offline-first Next.js PWA with Dexie IndexedDB sync, transactional outbox, Twenty CRM GraphQL contract layer, PDF/XLSX measurements, CEO metrics, and HMAC customer rating portals.
impact: In daily production for ~20 people across field, warehouse, dispatch, and management
640+ Vitest unit tests, Playwright smoke E2E, GitHub Actions CI, and a 600-line file-size ratchet (zero god files)
Offline capture survives dead zones and reconciles cleanly to Twenty CRM without duplicate writes

orcamentos_ia_platform.title: orcamentos-ia · Multi-Supplier Quoting Core
orcamentos_ia_platform.problem: Multi-brand quoting relied on manual PDF and spreadsheet lookup across 20+ suppliers—sales and technicians waited days while unit prices had to stay auditable.
orcamentos_ia_platform.built: Modular FastAPI and React platform with per-supplier pricing plug-ins, Docling/Celery PDF ingestion, deterministic width×height pricing, and tool-only LLM line-item assistance.
impact: 124k+ deterministic pricing tiers across 20+ supplier catalogs with zero price hallucination
Collapsed quote turnaround from days to minutes with frozen, auditable unit prices per proposal
Writes proposals directly into Twenty CRM alongside measurements from the field PWA

zohosync_habitarmos.title: ZohoSync · ERP-to-CRM Commercial Intelligence
zohosync_habitarmos.problem: Commercial leadership tracked a 500+ distributor network on disconnected spreadsheets instead of live ERP-backed objectives and stalled-deal signals.
zohosync_habitarmos.built: FastAPI and Redis incremental bridge syncing PHC SQL Server into Zoho Bigin EU with live rep KPIs, gap-to-target tracking, and geospatial distributor analytics.
impact: Synced 893 accounts, 2,405 contacts, and ~2k pipeline records for live commercial tracking
Surfaces gap-to-target, stalled deals, and at-risk accounts across 500+ distributors
Feeds HABITAI commercial coaching views and executive reporting

container_risk_radar_habitarmos.title: Container Risk Radar · Fleet Observability
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.problem: Multi-brand websites, containers, hosts, and 80+ workflows were monitored across separate tools, turning incident triage into manual log hunting.
container_risk_radar_habitarmos.built: Docker Compose observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, Grafana Alloy, Alertmanager, a Python YAML-weighted risk engine, and a Next.js SSE dashboard.
impact: Computes an explainable per-container risk score (0.0–1.0) across containers, hosts, and n8n workflows
Routes live degradation and sync-failure alerts directly to Slack and Telegram
Replaced manual multi-tool checks with one operational view for early failure detection

alygen_crm_b2b.title: Alygen CRM · B2B Audit & Outreach Engine
alygen_crm_b2b.problem: Manual B2B prospecting took ~2 hours per company for technical site checks, competitor research, and tailored Portuguese proposals.
alygen_crm_b2b.built: Open-source polyglot CRM (React, Node.js Express, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, SQLite WAL failover) with 12+ Chromium audits, RandomForest scoring, and multi-channel dispatch.
impact: Closed €20k+ in freelance B2B work after prospecting and auditing 6,000+ SMBs
Scaled outreach from ~4 to ~200 leads/day with localized proposals generated in under 3 minutes
Backed by 65+ automated tests (Vitest, Pytest) and GitHub Actions CI

lfg_discord_bot.title: LFG Valorant · Discord Community Platform
lfg_discord_bot.problem: Portugal's largest Valorant LFG guild (~13k members) coordinated matches via manual chat codes that broke down at peak load.
lfg_discord_bot.built: Open-source Discord bot, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL lobby state machine, gamification layer, and React OAuth PWA with GDPR self-erasure.
impact: 4,186 structured LFG requests created per week in production (~13k members, ~11.9k peak online)
380k+ lifetime LFG requests tracked with ~+35% higher channel activity after migration
Containerized with Docker Compose and automated CI (pytest, ruff, mypy)

other_work.summary: 55 internal initiatives prioritized directly with leadership by ROI and payback (~465h/month saved, ~28-day average delivery) across commercial, warehouse, accounting, and marketing (carrier alerts, marketing Kanban sync, order-to-CRM intake).

other_work.summary: R&D harness running coding agents inside disposable Docker sandboxes with deterministic pytest/compiler gates, human git-diff approval in Mission Control (React 19), Langfuse/OpenTelemetry traces, and pgvector instinct memory. Transparent alpha lab.

other_work.title: LinkedIn Jobfinder Scout · Agentic Career Intelligence (Open Source)
other_work.summary: Dual-memory system (pgvector/Qdrant) with LangGraph/CrewAI agents, structured CV ingestion, transparent skill-overlap matching, and 2-page ATS PDF export.

other_work.title: Casa · Self-Hosted Home OS (Personal Lab)
other_work.summary: Single 24/7 Linux server (Docker Compose, LAN-only—separate from employer infrastructure): Home Assistant control plane, dual-channel panel metering for previously unmetered PV, surplus→DHW loop with tank probe and hysteresis (bill savings pending invoice validation), and household-adopted apps (Mealie, Paperless-ngx, Immich, Jellyfin, AdGuard).
